lines.zh: 冰霜覆盖的长剑劈向地面。

lines.en: Ice crystals float in the cold wind.
Cold like a blade, chilling to the bone.
I walk on ice lotuses, one blooming per step.

lines.zh: 扇面轻摇，霜顺着衣角爬。
lines.en: A flick of the fan and frost climbs my hem.

lines.zh: 阴冷的目光，如刀锋般锐利。
lines.en: Cold gaze, sharp as a blade.

lines.zh: 冰霜覆盖的长剑，静立不动。
lines.en: Sword covered in ice, stands still.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都在它的视线中。
lines.en: Your every move is within its sight.
You're surrounded by its cold light.

lines.zh: 寒光闪烁，如刀锋般锐利。
lines.en: Cold light flickers, sharp as a blade.
Cold like a blade, stabbing your heart.

lines.zh: 你被寒光包围，难以逃脱。
lines.en: Surrounded by cold light, hard to escape.

lines.zh: 它的目光如冰，冻结了你。
lines.en: Its gaze like ice, freezing you.

lines.zh: 寒风中，它的视线穿透黑暗。
lines.en: In the cold wind, its sight pierces the darkness.

lines.zh: 你手中的扇子，引我出洞。
冰封你的灵魂，吞噬光明。
lines.en: Freeze your soul, devour the light.
Feed on human blood for immortality.

lines.zh: 阳光下，我是最可怕的影。
lines.en: In the sunlight, I am the scariest shadow.

lines.zh: 寒冰环绕，是我不灭的守护。
lines.en: Frost surrounds me, my unending guard.
Follow me, become an evil spirit.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我的獠牙最锋利。
lines.en: In the dark, my fangs are sharpest.
I cannot avoid the sunlight here.
My shadow is faster than light.
In the dark, I am the strongest.
You can't hit me; I can dodge.
My blood is cold and merciless.
Avoid the light, or I will kill you.
In sunlight, I am very weak.
Join me,童磨, live and die together.
Mate with me, continue the evil line.

lines.zh: 童磨，你是我唯一的伴侣。
lines.en: Only you,童磨, are my partner.
You,童磨, are my evil companion.
You,童磨, share the darkness with me.
Join me,童磨, to our end.
Together with you, we meet our end.

lines.zh: 汲取无惨之血，力量倍增。
lines.en: Suck the blood of Wu Can, and your power will double.

lines.zh: 这把扇子，扇出死亡之风。
lines.en: This fan, a wind of death.

lines.zh: 帽子遮挡阳光，我不会被击败。
lines.en: My hat shields from the sun, I won't be defeated.

lines.zh: 上衣赋予我强大，袴提升速度。
lines.en: The shirt boosts my power, the pants speed me up.

lines.zh: 躲避阳光，夜色为我遮掩。
lines.en: Avoid the sun, night hides me.

lines.zh: 折扇扇起寒意，冰封敌人。
lines.en: Fan the cold, freeze your foes.
Blood of Wu Can, bring back Doma.

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，我的时刻到了。

lines.en: Upper Rank Two has laid eyes on you.
The hand on your blade is frosting over.
I have seen plenty of Demon Slayer blades.
Seeking me at night is your misfortune.

lines.zh: 再走一步，你的肺就冻住了。
lines.en: One more step and your lungs freeze.

lines.zh: 冰之意志，贯穿你的灵魂。

lines.en: Blood of Wu Can, gives me strength.
Avoid the sun, or you die.

lines.zh: 童磨的上衣，增强我攻击力。

lines.en: Pants increase speed, making me faster.
The ice has already spread to your feet.
I smile, and the frost falls.
Don't swing; it will only slow you.

lines.zh: 冰莲开满，你就没处站了。
lines.en: When the ice lotuses bloom, you'll have nowhere to stand.
I cast to the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 你的刀气，被寒气压住了。
lines.en: My cold smothers the edge of your blade.
The fan snaps shut and the art takes form.
Retreat into sunlight? Dawn is far off.

lines.zh: 我抬手，冰柱从地上长出。
lines.en: I raise a hand; ice pillars sprout from the ground.
The warmth coming off you is far too loud.

lines.zh: 扇子一扇，冰爬满你的脚。
lines.en: One wave of my fan and ice climbs your legs.
My ice has your feet stuck.

lines.zh: 冰莲一开，你就动不了了。
lines.en: The ice lotus blooms and you freeze.
My fan ribs crack against your blade's spine!
Ice spikes shoot from my sleeve!
Cold air crawls into your lungs!

lines.zh: 冰刃贴着你的颈侧划过！
lines.en: An ice blade skims your neck!
I slam you into the ice wall!

lines.zh: 你的刀落下时，已经钝了。
lines.en: By the time your blade falls, it is dull.
Smiling, I close my hand on your throat.
The art bursts, leaving ice needles everywhere!

lines.zh: 雪落下来的时候，我睁开眼。
lines.en: When the snow falls, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 冰结的血鬼术，先从你脚下起。
lines.en: My frozen art begins beneath your feet.
Blood of Wu cann, strengthens me!

lines.zh: 夜色一深，我就站在那儿。
lines.en: As the night deepens, I am simply standing there.

lines.zh: 林间忽然起了雾，我来了。
lines.en: Mist rises in the woods; I have come.
I close my fan and step into the moonlight.
